• Announced topline and post-hoc data from the randomized portion of PALISADE-4, a Phase 3 study designed to assess the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of fasedienol for the acute treatment of social anxiety disorder.

• Announced topline results from an exploratory Phase 2 repeat dose study of fasedienol, designed to assess the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of two 3.2 µg doses of fasedienol administered ten minutes apart compared with a single 3.2 µg dose and placebo, for the acute treatment of social anxiety.
